remarks: Welcome to CMK Builder's stunning Zachary Model. Located in the highly desired Alden School district, you'll find this 1,924 sq. ft. modern Colonial, thoughtfully designed with today’s lifestyle in mind, all on a 1.53 acre lot. Offering 3 bedrooms with the potential for a 4th, this home blends timeless style with modern comfort in an open, airy layout. Step inside to find a bright and welcoming open floor plan, highlighted by a dramatic great room with cathedral ceilings and a beautiful gas fireplace with a tiled surround to the mantle—the perfect centerpiece for relaxing or entertaining. The first floor features durable and stylish luxury vinyl plank flooring, along with a convenient half bath for guests. The kitchen is designed to impress, featuring your choice of quartz or granite countertops and KraftMaid soft-close cabinetry, allowing you to tailor the space to your personal style. Upstairs, you’ll find two full bathrooms, including a spacious primary suite with a private en-suite bath and walk-in closet, offering a peaceful retreat at the end of the day. Enjoy the added benefit of 8-foot ceilings on every level—including the basement, providing a sense of openness throughout and future finishing potential. Outdoor living is just as inviting with a generous 32’ x 5’ covered front porch and a 15’ x 15’ covered rear porch, perfect for enjoying quiet mornings or hosting gatherings. Additional features include a large 22’ x 22’ two-car garage with insulated doors and an up to 100' blacktop driveway, completing the home’s thoughtful design and curb appeal. This is a wonderful opportunity to own a beautifully crafted home that combines quality finishes, flexible living space, and classic charm. This is a "To Be Built Home", the floor plan can be adjusted to more meet your needs, other floor plans are available or can be created. Built with quality and efficiency in mind, the home includes Andersen windows, a high-efficiency furnace, 50-gallon hot water tank, and a durable 50-year architectural shingle roof. This is a rare chance to build a beautiful new home with quality finishes on a spacious lot located just a short distance from all conveniences.
